method: Actual installed registered package paths executed with every package file and directory already nonwritable (0444/0555); copied packages independently chmod0444/0555 prove same-text rewrite/new-file/new-directory denial. Fresh writable caller output/TMPDIR; ordinary Python, no -B or PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE. Check inode,mtime,ctime,permissions and hash/tree membership before/after, not hashes alone.
